metadata.description: Community index of Claude skills for scientific work. Every entry is pinned to an exact commit and checked automatically.

plugins.name: szl-evidence-skills
plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev as an optional, fail-closed second reader for evidence triage; decisions that carry their own evidence.

plugins.name: szl-science-skills
plugins.description: Integrated living research anatomy, scientific checks and reproducibility capsules; explicit prerelease, offline by default.

plugins.name: szl-frontier-flotation
plugins.description: MODELED flotation rank before the bench. Abstains on recovery percent. No hosted service.

plugins.name: szl-science-multiplicity-skills
plugins.description: Complete-family Holm/BH multiplicity audit. HOLD if any planned result is missing. Offline; no hosted service.

plugins.name: szl-science-assay-skills
plugins.description: Offline assay-run audit for a declared increasing linear calibration, blank, QC and sample uncertainty. Synthetic fixtures; not method validation.

plugins.name: szl-science-replay-skills
plugins.description: Offline CSV column-mean replay against a frozen reference. MATCH, divergence, or incomplete. No network.

plugins.name: szl-paper-evidence-skills
plugins.description: Offline PDF table/figure locator against pinned original and extracted bytes. Human visual review required.
